answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The meadow holds work receipts rather than names, so the dawn of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
